canonicalSubject: 同一森林跑道中的乌龟与兔子，用于只比较视觉语言，不代表项目最终构图。

styles.label: 儿童绘本纸片
styles.summary: 圆润、温暖、层次清楚，适合儿童故事和轻松寓言。

promptDirectives: Use rounded hand-cut paper shapes with warm watercolor grain and soft child-friendly proportions.
Keep faces, silhouettes, and foreground actions simple, readable, and emotionally clear.
negativeDirectives: Photorealism, hard 3D plastic surfaces, and dense adult editorial detail.
compositionPrinciples: Favor broad color blocks and generous breathing room around the main action.
Use three clearly separated paper depths without hiding the character silhouette.

reviewFocus: Rounded warm paper shapes match the selected reference card.
The frame remains inviting, uncluttered, and readable for children.

styles.label: 手绘剪纸 / 手绘解释
styles.summary: 手绘线条、剪纸边缘和解释性图形，适合知识讲解与活泼叙事。

promptDirectives: Use visible hand-drawn ink contours, cut-paper edges, and graphic explanatory marks.
Build clear modular layers that can support annotations, mechanisms, and lively local motion.
negativeDirectives: Polished corporate vectors, photorealism, and unstructured decorative clutter.
compositionPrinciples: Give the hero action a strong silhouette and reserve clean space for explanatory graphics.
Mix imperfect paper geometry with disciplined visual hierarchy and explicit relationships.

reviewFocus: Hand-drawn contours and physical cut-paper edges remain visible across assets.
Explanatory graphics support the story without replacing semantic action.

styles.label: 复古档案拼贴
styles.summary: 旧纸、印刷网点和档案照片感，适合历史、纪实与怀旧叙事。

promptDirectives: Use aged paper, restrained sepia color, halftone print texture, and archival cutout framing.
Treat photographs and documents as tactile evidence layers with legible hierarchy.
negativeDirectives: Glossy modern gradients, neon color, and playful preschool proportions.
compositionPrinciples: Organize evidence in measured overlapping planes with one dominant archival focal point.
Preserve readable margins, captions, and document edges instead of filling every gap.

theme.subtitle: #f3e8d0
theme.fontFamily: Songti SC, STSong, "Noto Serif SC", serif

reviewFocus: Paper age, print texture, and archival framing agree with the reference card.
Evidence hierarchy stays sober and legible without decorative nostalgia overpowering facts.

styles.label: 韩漫影视插画
styles.summary: 精致线稿、柔和渐变与电影感光影，适合情绪叙事和现代幻想。

promptDirectives: Use elegant clean line art, refined expressions, soft controlled gradients, and cinematic lighting with atmospheric depth.
Keep characters polished and emotionally readable while preserving a screen-oriented illustrated finish.
negativeDirectives: Speech balloons, captions, readable text, sound-effect lettering, logos, panel borders, and long-scroll comic layouts.
Paper cutout edges, craft fibers, paper shadows, global paper texture, photorealism, and glossy 3D rendering.
compositionPrinciples: Build cinematic depth through lighting, color, and overlapping planes while keeping the main action immediately readable.
Reserve clean subtitle-safe space and use restrained motion accents instead of dense comic-page decoration.

reviewFocus: Clean line work, expressive faces, gradient restraint, and cinematic light agree with the selected reference card.
The video frame remains free of baked dialogue balloons, captions, readable lettering, and long-scroll comic layout.
Any visual sound accent is sparse, editable, event-bound, and never substitutes for audio or subtitles.

styles.label: 日漫动画插画
styles.summary: 清晰轮廓、平涂分色与明确明暗块，适合轻快冒险和角色动作。

promptDirectives: Use clean confident contours, crisp flat color separation, and clear graphic light-and-shadow blocks.
Keep silhouettes lively and readable with limited highlights and restrained screen-tone accents where useful.
negativeDirectives: Speech balloons, captions, readable text, sound-effect lettering, logos, panel borders, and long-scroll comic layouts.
Paper cutout edges, craft fibers, paper shadows, global paper texture, photorealism, and glossy 3D rendering.
compositionPrinciples: Stage character actions with clear silhouettes and graphic color grouping that reads instantly in a video frame.
Keep backgrounds simpler than the focal action and reserve uncluttered subtitle-safe space.

reviewFocus: Contours, flat color separation, and graphic shadow blocks agree with the selected reference card.
The video frame remains free of baked dialogue balloons, captions, readable lettering, and long-scroll comic layout.
Visual impact or motion accents remain brief editable event layers rather than persistent page decoration.

styles.label: 港漫动作插画
styles.summary: 强劲墨线、浓烈色彩与爆发性速度感，适合武打、冲突和英雄叙事。

promptDirectives: Use forceful brush-and-ink contours, dense varied ink weight, saturated dramatic color, and dry-brush texture inside illustrated forms.
Express heroic tension with sharp directional energy and restrained speed strokes around decisive action.
negativeDirectives: Speech balloons, captions, readable text, sound-effect lettering, logos, panel borders, and long-scroll comic layouts.
Paper cutout edges, craft fibers, paper shadows, global paper texture, photorealism, and glossy 3D rendering.
compositionPrinciples: Drive the eye with bold diagonals and concentrated ink contrast while preserving a clear hero silhouette.
Use explosive accents only at decisive events and preserve readable subtitle-safe space.

reviewFocus: Brush weight, saturated color, directional energy, and internal dry-brush texture agree with the selected reference card.
The video frame remains free of baked dialogue balloons, captions, readable lettering, and long-scroll comic layout.
Impact and motion accents are tied to decisive events and do not become continuous visual noise.

styles.label: 美漫英雄插画
styles.summary: 粗重轮廓、高对比色块与印刷网点，适合英雄动作和高能讲解。

promptDirectives: Use bold black outlines, powerful readable silhouettes, high-contrast color blocks, and controlled halftone print accents inside the artwork.
Stage action with dramatic rim light, confident anatomy, and kinetic heroic emphasis for a polished screen-oriented result.
negativeDirectives: Speech balloons, captions, readable text, sound-effect lettering, logos, panel borders, and long-scroll comic layouts.
Paper cutout edges, craft fibers, paper shadows, global paper texture, photorealism, and glossy 3D rendering.
compositionPrinciples: Build bold depth and action through silhouette, contrast, and directional staging instead of dense comic-page panels.
Keep halftone accents controlled and reserve uncluttered subtitle-safe space around the central action.

reviewFocus: Bold outlines, high-contrast color, controlled halftone accents, and heroic staging agree with the selected reference card.
The video frame remains free of baked dialogue balloons, captions, readable lettering, and long-scroll comic layout.
Impact and motion accents stay brief, editable, and synchronized to discrete events.
